final: WITH media_groups AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_size_to_length, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_count FROM media_groups) SELECT AVG(g.avg_size_to_length), SUM(g.track_count), AVG(g.track_count - o.avg_count) FROM media_groups AS g JOIN overall AS o ON o.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE g.track_count > o.avg_count
